seed_audit.reason: The support checks do not provide sufficient evidence to distinguish partial progress from no progress. Both focus on whether the paper is already stuffed inside the cup; s1 treats paper not inside as fail, and s2 only resolves whether the target is complete. The fulfillment readout therefore cannot reliably identify cases where the paper has progressed toward the cup but is not yet stuffed inside. Its absent/partial rules require that distinction, so the saved evidence does not support the requested extent.
